name: Yaourt Malo
verdict: Dairy brand of the Laiterie de Saint-Malo, chaired by SILL Entreprises, the family business behind the SILL chest sponsor, which also publishes the Malo website. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: the company register lists SILL ENTREPRISES as Président de SAS of the Laiterie de Saint-Malo; malo.fr is published by SILL ENTREPRISES. No state or fund stake found → none. Malo is a club partner (business.sb29.bzh/partenaire/yaourt-malo/) but is not on the 2026-27 home shirt in the club's launch or shop photos.
